outcome: On-treatment and postpartum alanine aminotransferase (ALT) flares in mothers
Viral rebound after TAF cessation in mothers
cohort: HBeAg-positive mothers with HBV DNA levels > 2,000,000 IU/mL who initiated TAF therapy between gestational weeks 26 and 28, and their infants.
finding: Approximately 2% of infants experienced vertical transmission despite maternal TAF therapy and infant immunoprophylaxis, and 0.8% of infants had a congenital malformation at birth.
